messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v3.5.0 -> 10% across default regions. Started by lin. Cmd: `/deploy start --version v3.5.0 --percent 10 --note \"perf patch + tokenizer fix\"`

lin: kicking this off. preflight OK. change window is 02:00-05:00 UTC. i'll watch traces and perf.

asha: thumbs up from product. release notes updated: https://docs.redwood/releases/v3.5.0. Please capture any customer-impacting behavior.

nate: watching infra. adding SRE checklist: watch kv-eviction, backend grpc errors, and model-host mem. will flag if anything exceeds thresholds.

alert-bot: NOTICE: region ap-south tokenization-error-rate increased to 0.6% (threshold 0.4%). Recent deploys: v3.5.0 canary.

lin: seeing the ap-south spike too on the quickview. traces show tokenizer rejects for a small subset of requests (lang=hi).

asha: is this a data-induced error or a code regression? Any regressions in tokenizer library?

lin: diffs show tokenization change in v3.5.0 to handle rare unicode sequences, but the new branch may fallback incorrectly for some locales.

nate: My recommendation: PAUSE percent bumps and PIN the rollout while we triage. If we can hotfix tokenizer fallback quickly we can revert the small change instead of full rollback.

release-manager: Vote: HOLD. We need a short blurb for support and a customer-facing line if it becomes widespread. Also note the change window restriction; prefer fast mitigation over rollback to respect churn.

lin: Agreed. i'll open a revert PR for the tokenizer fallback NOW.

deploy-bot: Action: `/release pin v3.5.0 --scope ap-south --reason \"tokenizer errors ap-south\" --initiator lin` recorded. Bumps disabled for pinned scope.

alert-bot: ALERT: ap-south tokenization errors 0.9% (3m window). Escalate if >1.0% or sustained.

nate: If revert PR isn't green in 15m, we should prepare full rollback playbook: `/deploy rollback --version v3.4.9 --percent 100`. I'll stage the rollback command but not run it yet.

asha: @lin please add one-liner for support: "We are investigating tokenization errors affecting certain languages in AP-South; fixes in progress." Keep it short so support can triage.

lin: Draft for support: "Investigating tokenization errors affecting a small subset of AP-South requests (some Indic locales). Engineers are triaging; mitigation in flight." Ready to paste to #support when asked.

release-manager: Documenting decision: short mitigation path = revert tokenizer fallback (PR #4821). Contingency = rollback to v3.4.9. Postmortem owner = lin.

deploy-bot: Thread state: PINNED (scope: ap-south). To resume: `/deploy resume --version v3.5.0 --scope ap-south` after approval from release-manager.

lin: PR opened and running CI: https://git.redwood/pr/4821. ETA for deploy if green ~12-18m.

nate: I'll run a targeted canary revert plan in staging and verify traces. If revert fixes tokenization errors, we can unpin and continue rollout. If not, we'll run rollback.

alert-bot: NOTE: metrics stable elsewhere. Only ap-south impacted.

release-manager: Re-eval in 15m or earlier on CI status. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Recorded: change window 02:00-05:00 UTC; rollback runbook: https://wiki.redwood/releases/runbooks/rollback. Keep channel updated.
